meta.name: GatorPlate design tokens
meta.css_rule: Every key in color, font, type, space, radius, shadow, motion, effect, size and print is the CSS custom property --gp-<key> in the first :root rule of web/shared/tokens.css, with exactly the same value. No other file defines colors or fonts.
meta.contrast_rule: tools/check_contrast.py checks every pair in contrast_pairs with the WCAG 2.2 formula: kind text >= 4.5:1 (SC 1.4.3), kind large >= 3:1 (text at least 24px, or at least 18.66px bold), kind ui >= 3:1 (borders, lines, focus rings and graphics, SC 1.4.11). Any foreground/background combination that is not listed here is not allowed in the UI.

fonts.family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, the only font family (upright and italic variable WOFF2, SIL Open Font License 1.1, web/shared/fonts/OFL.txt)
fonts.file_states: Each file is "present: ..." (on disk, used by an active @font-face rule in web/shared/tokens.css, and a row in NOTICE.md) or "missing: ..." (not on disk, its @font-face rule prepared but commented out, no NOTICE.md row). A present note gives the file's version (from the font's name table), its NOTICE.md row gives the same version, and that row's copyright line is also a line at the top of the OFL.txt next to the file. tools/check_contrast.py fails when these disagree.

files.web/shared/fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegibleNex: present: italic, variable weight 200-800, version 2.001, Latin subset
present: upright, variable weight 200-800, version 2.001, Latin subset

fonts.numerals: tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, token num) for every amount, time, countdown and case code; case codes (.code) use the text family with tracking-code

font.font-italic: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Italic", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif
